name: Eyes for the Watchman
summary: Eleanor asks you to carry a care package to Watcher Fredericks at Southern Watch. Her ranch duties keep her from delivering it herself.

sections.title: A Gift for Fredericks
sections.body: Watcher Fredericks patrols past Eleanor's ranch, and she has prepared a small gift for him. With her brother to watch and the ranch to tend, she asks you to carry it to Southern Watch, west of her home.

faq.answer: Eleanor's care package is for Watcher Fredericks, who is stationed at Southern Watch.

faq.q: Why can't Eleanor deliver it herself?
faq.answer: Eleanor needs to watch her little brother and tend to the ranch.
Watcher Fredericks is stationed at Southern Watch, west of Eleanor's ranch.

faq.q: Why did Eleanor prepare a gift?
faq.answer: Fredericks sometimes patrols past the ranch, and Eleanor wants to show her appreciation.

faq.q: How does Fredericks react to the package?
faq.answer: Fredericks thanks you for delivering Eleanor's gift and says he will return the favor sometime.
